meta.title: Become a partner · Clafina
meta.description: Apply to partner with Clafina as an accountant, bookkeeper or implementation firm. Tell us about your firm and we will share the programme details.

title: Partner with Clafina.
lede: Tell us about your firm and the clients you serve. We will come back to you with the programme details and the next steps.

expect.title: The programme details
expect.body: We share how the partner programme works once we know a little about your firm.

expect.title: A conversation about your clients
expect.body: We talk through the trades you serve and how Clafina would fit their work.

expect.title: Help getting started
expect.body: We show you how to work across your clients' organisations, packs and imports.
